newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Romatex sees larger than expected loss.
newsitem.headline: Romatex sees larger than expected loss.

text.p: Textiles firm Romatex Limited said on Friday it anticipated more adverse results than previously anticipated and consequently renewed its cautionary announcement to shareholders.
The group published a cautionary on May 9 forecasting a loss before tax for the nine months to end-June 1997.

It said at the time major shareholders agreed that the only way to arrest the loss would be to rationalise the company's activities with those of Consolidated Frame Textiles Ltd. The companies said that, in terms of an arrangement with majority shareholder CG Smith Ltd, a scheme of arrangement would be proposed to ordinary shareholders.
In terms of the scheme, the shares of all members of Romatex -- other than Confram and Santhold Investments Ltd -- would be cancelled.
In a joint announcement with Confram on Friday, Romatex said its results for the period ending June 1997 would be published before any further announcement was made regarding the proposed scheme.
This was to ensure that Romatex shareholders were fully informed about its financial position.
It said the results would be published around August 12, followed by a further announcement shortly afterwards.
The companies warned Romatex shareholders to continue excercising caution in their sharedealings until the further announcement was made.
